examples.japanese: {自治会|じちかい}に{入|はい}る。
{自治会|じちかい}の{会議|かいぎ}が{今月|こんげつ}ある。
examples.english: There's a residents' association meeting this month.

examples.japanese: {自治会|じちかい}が{地域|ちいき}の{防災|ぼうさい}{訓練|くんれん}を{企画|きかく}している。
examples.english: The residents' association is planning a local disaster preparedness drill.

notes:
A voluntary neighborhood organization that manages local community affairs such as garbage collection schedules, festivals, disaster preparedness, and communication from the municipal government. Membership is technically voluntary but socially expected in many areas. Found throughout Japan under various names.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自治会|じちかい}{長|ちょう}: head of the residents' association
- {自治会|じちかい}{費|ひ}: association dues
- {自治会|じちかい}の{活動|かつどう}: association activities
- {自治会|じちかい}に{加入|かにゅう}する: to join the association

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {町内会|ちょうないかい}: neighborhood association — essentially the same organization; the name varies by region
- {町会|ちょうかい}: neighborhood association — a shorter variant used in some areas
- {管理組合|かんりくみあい}: management association — used specifically for condominium/apartment building management
